title: Phase-Conditioned Affordance Fields for SE(3)-Equivariant Visuomotor Policies
abstract: arXiv:2610.17281v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: SE(3)-equivariance provides a useful geometric inductive bias for visuomotor policies, encoding that actions covary with rigid transformations of the observation. However, existing SE(3)-equivariant visuomotor policies build this bias on a global equivariance assumption that treats the entire observation as governed by a single rigid transformation, which breaks down in real-world manipulation tasks where the task-relevant region changes across different objects. We address this by learning a phase-conditioned affordance field (PAF) over the observed point cloud, a per-point score that the SE(3)-equivariant policy uses in two complementary ways. Its score-weighted centroid serves as a learned, phase-conditioned anchor that canonicalizes the observation and the action around the active region, replacing the fixed gripper-frame reference, and the score itself is appended as a per-point feature. translated_title: 面向SE(3)等变视觉运动策略的相位条件可供性场
translated_abstract: SE(3)等变性为视觉运动策略提供了一种有用的几何归纳偏置，其编码了动作随观测的刚体变换而协变的特性。然而，现有的SE(3)等变视觉运动策略将这种偏置建立在全局等变假设之上，即把整个观测视为受单一刚体变换支配，这在真实世界的操作任务中会失效，因为任务相关区域会随不同物体而变化。我们通过在观测点云上学习相位条件可供性场（PAF）来解决这一问题，这是一种逐点评分，SE(3)等变策略以两种互补的方式使用它：其得分加权质心作为一个学习到的、相位条件化的锚点，将观测和动作规范化到活跃区域周围，取代固定的夹爪坐标系参考；同时该评分本身作为逐点特征被附加使用。这引入了一种局部几何归纳偏置……
tldr: 该论文提出相位条件可供性场（PAF），通过学习逐点评分构建局部几何归纳偏置，并以得分加权质心作为自适应锚点取代固定夹爪坐标系参考，解决了现有SE(3)等变视觉运动策略全局等变假设在真实操作任务中失效的问题。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes a Phase-conditioned Affordance Field (PAF) that learns per-point scores as a local geometric inductive bias, using the score-weighted centroid as an adaptive anchor to replace the fixed gripper-frame reference, thereby addressing the failure of global equivariance assumptions in existing SE(3)-equivariant visuomotor policies for real-world manipulation tasks.
